ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB=18\,cm$, C is the midpoint of $AB$. Point D is on line segment $AC$, and $AD:CB=1:3$, what is the length of $DC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because AB=18$cm, and $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$,\\
$\therefore AC=BC=\frac{1}{2}AB=9$cm,\\
$\because AD:CB=1:3$,\\
$\therefore AD=3$cm,\\
$\therefore DC=AC-AD=9-3=\boxed{6}$cm.
